description: PROVISIONAL accelerometer conventions for the 9 retained unique writers. Historical B/C/D/E are duplicate identities of A and are excluded from the active dataset. Confirm acquisition API.
caveats: Linear acceleration subjects are left unchanged.
For raw acceleration, low-pass filtering estimates the slowly varying gravity component and subtracts it on each axis; this is not exact inertial gravity separation.
Low frequency handwriting dynamics can also be suppressed, especially in short trials. Verify sensor coordinates, sample timing and acquisition field definitions.
Historical B/C/D/E were duplicate folders of writer A, now retired. Never interpret legacy 13-class results as distinct-writer identity accuracy.
Old 13-class checkpoints and summaries are invalid for the 9-identity dataset. Train a fresh model; do not reuse the old checkpoint.
